rung: canonical two-seed replay-free online residual acquisition with old-boundary retention
claim_boundary: A frozen external detector plus a zero-initialized gated residual learns partially overlapping shifts from fresh scalar utilities while retaining stable and disjoint boundaries. This is a bounded anti-forgetting mechanism, not general continual learning.

accounting.stable_bits_to_threshold: 1000 pretraining updates plus 144 fresh online scalar utilities; partial replacement and old-boundary retention passed on both seeds
accounting.retention_on_mastered_primitives: stable keep and exact stable/disjoint shift behavior remained at 1.0 on both seeds after residual growth
accounting.transfer_ratio_against_fresh_detector: trained partial-overlap accuracy was 0.8203 and 0.8906; fresh partial controls were 0.0 on both seeds

controls: exact stable and fully shifted post-adaptation retention
negative_control: The naive single-policy online update was archived after partial replacement reached 1.0 but stable keep collapsed to 0.0.
next_bottleneck: Growing multiple residual slots, routing them without task labels, consolidating/compressing external state, and testing long nonstationary streams with arbitrary new boundaries.
